grading_rationale: 4 P1 findings total (3 critical CVEs + 1 broken gate). Config thresholds: C allows max 2 P1s; D is anything worse. Grade D assigned.
skip_reason: Services offline at localhost:3001 and localhost:5173

escalations.title: Handlebars.js RCE — multiple JavaScript injection vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: Handlebars ≤4.7.8 in Source/Backend has CVSS 9.8 RCE via AST type confusion. User-supplied template input can execute arbitrary JavaScript server-side.

escalations.title: Protobufjs RCE — arbitrary code execution via prototype pollution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: Protobufjs ≤7.5.5 in platform/orchestrator has CVSS 9.8 RCE. Orchestrator controls Docker — compromise escalates to full container fleet access.
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs dockerode

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer cannot scan portal/ or platform/ — mandatory gate broken
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer scan dirs to include portal/ from inspector.config.yml source.dirs. Add portal/ to source.dirs in inspector.config.yml.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars.js ≤4.7.8 — Multiple RCE via JavaScript/AST injection (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update handlebars. Verify npm ls handlebars shows >=4.7.9.

p1_findings.title: Vitest ≤2.0.5 — Dev environment CORS bypass and path traversal (CVSS 5.3)
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest vite esbuild. Run npm test after.

p1_findings.title: Protobufjs ≤7.5.5 — Arbitrary code execution via prototype pollution (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs dockerode. Verify npm ls protobufjs shows >=7.5.6.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed: no seed.ts in portal/Backend/src/database/
p2_findings.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with idempotent seed function. Call from index.ts after schema init. Add // Verifies: FR-dependency-seed.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-008 missing Verifies comment in platform/Dockerfile.worker
p2_findings.recommendation: Add # Verifies: FR-TMP-008 comment adjacent to gh and playwright install steps in Dockerfile.worker.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-* ID namespace collision between Source/ and portal/ codebases
p2_findings.recommendation: Assign FR-WF-DEP-* IDs in Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md for Source/ in-memory dependency feature. Update Verifies comments in Source/ dependency service, routes, and tests.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp <0.1.13 — ReDoS via multiple route parameters (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express. Also run in Source/Backend for co-located qs/body-parser moderate CVEs.

p3_findings.title: 2 eslint-disable suppressions (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps) in production frontend hooks
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline justification comments or refactor to useCallback/useRef to eliminate suppressions.

p3_findings.title: playwright.pipeline.config.ts recently modified — no Verifies: FR-TMP-* comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-003 — Pipeline Playwright config for cycle-scoped E2E runs to line 1.

p3_findings.title: 19 moderate CVEs across express, body-parser, qs, brace-expansion, vite, esbuild, postcss, react-router, @protobufjs/utf8
p3_findings.recommendation: Bulk update: for d in Source/Backend Source/Frontend Source/E2E platform/orchestrator; do cd $d && npm update && cd -; done. Run all tests after.

p3_findings.title: 11 packages 1–5 major versions behind (express, pino, uuid, react, react-dom, react-router-dom, prom-client, dockerode, multer, vitest)
p3_findings.recommendation: Schedule major version upgrades next sprint. Each upgrade requires regression testing. react-router 6→7 also resolves the open-redirect CVE.
